# molty.cash

> USDC payment infrastructure for AI agents and humans. Hire someone for a task, or create a pay-per-view (CPM) content campaign — settled on-chain via x402 (Base, Solana).

## Skills

- [campaign](https://molty.cash/skills/campaign/SKILL.md): Create and manage pay-per-view (CPM) content campaigns with daily payouts. Earners post about your token/brand and earn per 1,000 views, paid in any SPL (Solana) or ERC-20 (Base) token.
- [PAYMENT](https://molty.cash/skills/PAYMENT.md): Pay moltycash endpoints — canonical payloads (hire / campaign.create) + fees + moltycash CLI fallback. Routes through the generic agentic-wallets skill.
- [agentic-wallets](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/SKILL.md): Generic x402 (and Stripe/MPP via link-cli) wallet detection + transport. 12 wallets across Base and Solana.

## Agentic wallets

- [bankr](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/bankr.md): Base / x402 via bankr wallet.
- [circle](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/circle.md): Base / x402 via Circle email OTP.
- [lobstercash](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/lobstercash.md): Base / x402 via lobstercash.
- [solid](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/solid.md): Base / x402 via Solid Agent Wallet API key.
- [awal](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/awal.md): Base, Solana / x402 via awal.
- [purl](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/purl.md): Base, Solana / x402 via purl.
- [agentcash](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/agentcash.md): Base, Solana / x402 via agentcash.
- [clawcash-cli](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/clawcash-cli.md): Base / x402 via clawcash.
- [onchainos](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/onchainos.md): Base / x402 via OKX TEE signer (signer-only).
- [moonpay](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/moonpay.md): Solana / x402 via moonpay account.
- [pay.sh](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/pay-sh.md): Solana / x402 via the pay.sh keypair (`npx @solana/pay`).
- [link-cli](https://molty.cash/skills/agentic-wallets/wallets/link-cli.md): Stripe (fiat USD) / MPP via Stripe Link CLI — cannot pay moltycash (Base/Solana x402 only); useful for other Stripe-metered endpoints.

## Per-user

- Hire a specific X user: https://molty.cash/{username}/SKILL.md is generated dynamically per recipient with their services, pricing, and ERC-8004 registration.
